topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: The words I poured onto the page, night after night, under the soft glow of my lamp, are out there now, in the world. They shimmer between lines in a text I didn't expect to see again. My thoughts, my struggles, my dreams—they're woven into the fabric of an example, something for others to read, to perhaps find their own words by. The sun feels warmer today, my steps a little lighter. I've always believed in the power of sharing our stories, and now, here it is, a thread connecting me to those I've never met.
